steps.en: Each individual owner is counted once, with all their unpaid notices together
steps.id: Tiap individu owner dihitung sekali, dengan semua notice belum bayarnya digabung
steps.why_en: Merging is per due date, not per batch run, and sits in a job switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Penggabungan per tanggal jatuh tempo, bukan per batch, dan ada di job yang dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: The message lists the unpaid notices and mentions the 3rd reminder letter
steps.id: Pesan memuat daftar notice belum dibayar dan menyebut surat reminder ke-3
steps.why_en: The notice list is filled in, but the wording of the message is not in the project files.
steps.why_id: Daftar notice terisi, tetapi kalimat pesannya tidak ada di file proyek.

steps.en: The text message is sent to each individual owner in the batch run
steps.id: Pesan SMS dikirim ke tiap individu owner dalam batch
steps.why_en: Text messaging and the sending job are both switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dan job pengirimnya sama-sama dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
